scope: Live private Photon room: rendered Editor host and two independent Realtime peers. Verifies transport, sender ownership, shared progress, late join and host handoff. Remote rendered UI and physical Android are not verified.

checks.name: Independent clients share an invisible private room
Native player retains local control ownership
Remote replica cannot consume host input
Development host can open Admin while the monster test drawer is collapsed
Admin cannot complete a topic that has never been activated
Guest-forged complete/reset commands cannot mutate progress or consume its valid command sequence
Admin action has an unobstructed UI click target
Complete active topic skips every remaining challenge, stops its clock and releases the team topic reservation
Completing a topic preserves other topic states, recorded mistake identity and monster mistake count
